'''Courtney Haggerty''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Utah tournament]] in January 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops: Let's build us a DS2]], according to Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1642">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-smeg-goes-to-ghetto-valley-take-1d1642/ smeg-goes-to-ghetto-valley-take-1], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 18 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-18-smeg-goes-to-ghetto-valley-take-1d1642/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
